identity.role: role_<input position padded to two digits>
identity.row: row_<result position padded to two digits>

ordering.rows: provider row order after complete-draft validation
ordering.cells: request input order within every row
ordering.unmappedRequirements: request input order, then source order within each role

cardinality.cells: exactly one per role in every row
cardinality.listedRequirements: no more than sixteen assessed per role
cardinality.unmappedRequirements: zero to ninety-six explicitly not assessed per role
